scope.description: Whole prusaslicer application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Mesh preparation/placement, printer/material/print profiles, slicing, supports, modifiers, multi-material workflows, preview and printer integration.

coverage.rationale: The central slice-to-G-code workflow is present, but advanced support/modifier/material and printer integration features are missing.

scope.description: One closed STL to bounded single-extruder FFF G-code with explicit profiles and layer/temperature/filament inspection.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: A print profile and independently interpreted layer/filament deliverables hide CLI/G-code plumbing, while many machine/material decisions remain explicit.

limitations: No supports, variable layers, custom/postprocessed G-code, printer upload or physical print/safety claim; one extruder and generic Marlin 2 profile.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
